text:
Ibrahim: quick sync re: onboarding pipeline refactor. proposal: split the smoke runner into two modes: 'compat-check' (functional/tokenizer/kv) and 'perf-check' (hw-aware seeds + normalized metrics).
Keiko: I like splitting. Right now the monolith mixes concerns and it's hard to tell whether a failure is a correctness bug or just a different HW baseline.
Luis: FYI we have a backlog of flaky onboards where tokenization drift caused perf noise. If we separate, we can gate compat-check as blocking and perf-check as advisory for low-traffic models.
Maya: tradeoffs: more pipeline stages -> more moving parts and state to manage. But benefits: clearer failure semantics, cheaper fast gate.
Ibrahim: proposed flow: 1) registry fast-gate runs compat-check (token_roundtrip, end-to-end decode, kv smoke). 2) on success, spawn perf-check which picks seed-set per hw_class. perf-check can be async for cold models.
Keiko: seed-set semantics? We need versioned seed-sets keyed by (model_id, hw_class, seed_version). Bench runs must record seed_version.
Luis: also add 'bench_hardware' label to every artifact and add 'hw_baseline_id' for normalization. We'll compute a normalized_throughput for cross-hw comparison.
Maya: interface boundary note: the onboard orchestration should only pass a seed_set_id and hw_hint to the bench worker. Seed selection logic and seed-store should live in the sampling service behind an API. Keeps the runner stateless.
Ibrahim: good point. sampling service API: GET /seed?model=<id>&hw=<class>&mode=smoke|perf returns seed_set_id + s3_uri. If none found, returns recommended_fallback and is_cross_hw_proxy=true.
Keiko: plus an operator endpoint to create/approve seed-set drafts. harvest job should propose candidate sets and operators can accept/adjust.
Luis: we also need a canonicalization shim between tokenizer outputs for compat-check. shim rules: normalize whitespace, map unicode confusables, map special-tokens to SENTINEL, and compute token_diff_rate. If token_diff_rate > threshold -> block.
Maya: implementational split: registry schema change (preferred_hardware:list, accept_hw_fallback:bool), sampling service + seed-store, compat shim library, and small changes to onboard UI to show seed_set_id and token_diff_summary.
BenchBot: NOTE: bench artifacts will include fields: seed_set_id, bench_hardware, token_diff_rate, raw_throughput, normalized_throughput, seed_generation_method.
Ibrahim: ops policy: run compat-check synchronously for all onboards. Run perf-check synchronously for hot models or Dedicated/Private targets, otherwise schedule async and mark onboarding as 'perf-pending'.
Keiko: what about rollout decisions? rollout automation should refuse to compare metrics across different bench_hardware unless normalized_throughput exists and seed_set_ids match the target hw_class.
Luis: also add a simple CLI for SEs: `rbx seeds snapshot --model <id> --hw a100 --n 100` to produce a reproducible seed-set and upload. This helps debugging.
Maya: monitoring: dashboards must be split by bench_hardware and rotation_id. Add alerting for sudden token_diff_rate increases when rotation hits.
Ibrahim: backward compatibility: add migration script to assign existing global seed-sets to hw_class='global' and seed_version=1. New runs will prefer explicit hw seed-sets when available.
Keiko: ownership? I'll pick the registry + UI bits. Luis take sampling service and seed-store. Maya will spec the compat shim and the perf gating policy. Ibrahim will coordinate the RFC PR and runbook.
OnboardBot: ACTIONS: Keiko -> registry PR; Luis -> seed-store spike; Maya -> compat-shim prototype; Ibrahim -> RFC follow-up and runbook.
Ibrahim: timeline suggestion: compat-check fast-gate in 1 sprint, sampling service + seed-store in 2 sprints, UI and runbook next sprint. Revert to opt-in for 4 weeks.
Luis: sounds reasonable. One more request: add a small golden-rotation smoke that runs post-rotation comparing old vs new seed-set for X min and auto-revert if multi-signal drift detected.
Maya: agree. include token_diff artifact and rotation_id in bench metadata so we can trace.
Keiko: cool. i'll start the registry patch now and cc owners.
Luis: :thumbsup:
Maya: :rocket:
BenchBot: REMINDER: please include migration plan and data-retention policy for seed payloads in PR.
